title: Assessing risk in a home visit

questions.q: In "Purpose and limits of a visit", which of these is a key idea?
o: A visit checks safety and listens to the person.
Use their name and a calm tone.
List signs, rate and name the first action.
Use Person F and Person M case cards.

questions.q: In "Seeing: signs of risk", which of these is a key idea?
o: Note the source: seen, told or read.
A visit has limits: it is not a full assessment.
A visit checks safety and listens to the person.
Report a concern in the agreed time.

questions.q: In "Rating on the 3-level scale", which of these is a key idea?

questions.q: In "Talking with the person respectfully", which of these is a key idea?
